1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This Criminal Revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 15.09.1998 passed by 1st Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Moradabad in Case No. 2894 of 1994 convicting and sentencing revisionist under Section 7/17 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
Thereagainst accused-revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 87 of 1998 which has been dismissed by 5th Additional District and Sessions Judge, Moradabad vide judgment and order dated 11.03.1999.

entities.text: 5th Additional District and Sessions Judge, Moradabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This revision has been filed challenging both the aforesaid orders.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in Criminal Revision.
